findings.title: Missing Canary Protection
findings.description: Canaries or canary words are known values that are placed between a buffer and control data on the stack to monitor buffer overflows.

findings.title: Requires a Newer Runtime Than the Deployment Baseline (GLIBC floor 2.34 exceeds the built-in default baseline 2.28; set --glibc-baseline or BLINT_GLIBC_BASELINE to your deployment target to make this a policy finding)
findings.description: Every versioned symbol a binary imports carries a minimum version of the library that provides it.
